notes.title: Patch incoming!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, we wanted to share a quick update regarding our development since the release. First off, thanks so much to everyone for download and playing our game. We did not expect this amount of attention for a student game that we made, but we are incredibly thankful! [/p][p]Over the past week we have been working on make the game more stable, and implementing some quality of life features. We have a bunch planned and cant wait to release the update this week! [/p][p]Including, but not limited to:[/p][list][*][p]Fov Slider[/p][/*][*][p]VSync toggle[/p][/*][*][p]Damage indicator[/p][/*][*][p]20+ achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Improved collision[/p][/*][*][p]Improved enemy navigation[/p][/*][*][p]Improved wave balancing[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved input issues[/p][/*][/list][p]And more![/p][p][/p][p]If you are (or have) run into issues while playing our game, we kindly ask for you to head over to our [url="https://discord.gg/arM6XjtC"]Discord server[/url] so we can assist you further and help resolve the issue.[/p][p]Thanks again to everyone who played! See you soon :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619302/eced2beb3af13b6524acdb02764a6d886ecbf5fc.png"][/img][/p]
